_doc: Reference scenario for examples/custom_network/generate_custom_inputs.py. This file is valid JSON; fields whose names start with '_' are documentation only and are ignored by the generator.
name: scenario_doc_example
_name: Output scenario name. The generator writes files under the chosen output directory and uses this name for ns-3 scratch/output/<name> paths.
_num_npus: Number of host/rank nodes. Host IDs must be 0..num_npus-1.
_topology_file: Optional physical topology input. If present, do not also define switches, leaf_switches, spine_switches, or links. Supports legacy header and leaf/spine header.

_explicit_topology_alternative._doc: Instead of topology_file, define switches plus links directly in this scenario. switch IDs must be contiguous after host IDs.

traffic._doc: Exactly one of traffic or flows must be present. traffic generates Chakra workload plus HPCC-style flow.txt rows.
traffic._offsets: Allreduce pair distances by phase. First offset must be num_npus / 2; each next offset must halve the previous one.
traffic._bytes_per_flow: Payload bytes per generated send/recv flow. Must fit MsgEvent int limit.
traffic._start_time: Generated traffic start time. Use exactly one of start_time_ns, start_time_s, or legacy start_time in seconds.
traffic._include_reverse: true adds reverse traffic. With phase_order=forward_then_reverse, reverse phases are appended after forward phases. With phase_order=bidirectional_per_offset, each offset phase contains both directions.
traffic._phase_order: forward_then_reverse preserves the original generated ordering. bidirectional_per_offset matches HPCC flow_long_distance.txt: one bidirectional phase per offset.
traffic._phase_sync: per_rank chains each rank's generated communication nodes in row order. per_phase chains only across phase boundaries so same-phase nodes can be ready together.

_flows_alternative._doc: Use top-level flows instead of traffic for explicit point-to-point messages.
start_time can also be start_time_s or legacy start_time in seconds. fwd_mode is 0 flow-based, 1 packet-spray; legacy strategy is accepted only as a deprecated alias.

network._doc: Network block controls generated network_config.txt values.
network._default_fwd_mode: Default per-flow forwarding mode. 0 flow-based, 1 packet-spray. Explicit flows can override with fwd_mode; legacy strategy is accepted only as a deprecated alias.
network._flow_strategy: Flow-based switch strategy. 0 ECMP, 1 PathPinning. Use 1 for HPCC-Dev long-distance path pinning.
network._packet_strategy: Packet-based switch strategy used when fwd_mode=1. 0 round-robin packet spray, 1 random packet spray.
network._enable_trace: 0 disables packet-level tracing; 1 enables tracing for nodes in generated trace.txt.
network._qlen_monitor: Queue length monitor timing in ns.
network._link_down: Optional link failures. Each entry uses time_us/src/dst plus either link_idx or count. count expands to link_idx=1..count; generated network_config.txt uses HPCC-Dev LINK_DOWN count rows.
network._buffer_config: Optional MMU settings. Values accept B/KB/MB/GB suffixes; plain numbers are bytes. Ports with delay >=100us use long-distance headroom/reserve; switches with any long-distance port use long_buffer_size.
network._config_overrides: Optional raw network_config.txt overrides. Use this for base config keys such as ENABLE_PFC, ENABLE_QCN, CC_MODE, ACK_HIGH_PRIO, or USE_DYNAMIC_PFC_THRESHOLD.
network._ecn_thresholds: Each link bandwidth in the scenario/topology must have one threshold entry. The generator converts these into KMIN_MAP, KMAX_MAP, and PMAX_MAP.

_generated_files.flow.txt: HPCC-style flow rows: src dst pg dport bytes start_time_seconds fwd_mode.
_generated_files.trace.txt: Node IDs whose packet-level events are traced when ENABLE_TRACE=1.
_generated_files.workload/custom_traffic.<rank>.et: Chakra workload files generated from traffic/flows.
_generated_files.run_manifest.json: Resolved paths and runnable command arguments.
